svg.title: A question is answered from passages and every citation is checked by code
svg.text: The model answers from passages. Code checks every citation. Never the model.
each passage carries the ledger event ids behind its fields
each cited event: in the ledger, and among the shown passages
each named component: among the shown
anything else fails, and the page says the answer is unsupported
a citation can be looked up
the model never decides whether it cited well
floors, written first: retrieval 11 · the expected phrase 10 · every citation passes 12
Nano 9B NIM: 11 · 7 · 10, median 22 s Super VL 120B at medium effort, with the chain rule: 10 · 11 · 9, median 34 s
neither arm clears all three on 2026-11-04; the role is bound to the deliberate tier as the best measured arm, below floor
